Transform for the FetchResult<ReliabilityAssetToModelRelation> retrieved for the Reliability.AssetMapAssetDetailCriticalModelsCardList
component.
This transform is responsible for formatting / adding translated text next to certain fields (especially latestAlertActivity) of each
asset to model relation to make the objects more presentable in the UI.
Additionally, the transform also retrieves an asset importance numerical indicator shown in the card list
for each asset's importance level for each asset to model relation.
